subject: Staging test scope & success metrics — next steps and blocker escalation
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha@orchidai.com>, orchidai-poc@orchidai.com
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Staging test scope & success metrics — recap + kickoff items

Hi Samantha / Orchid AI team,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — appreciate the clear run-through of your inference patterns. Per our call, I wanted to capture a concise plan for the staging test and call out risks we identified so we can start triaging immediately. See the proposed acceptance criteria and owners below. Please review and flag anything missing.

1) Staging test scope (48h smoke run):
- Dataset: 5k representative prompts (mix: 40% short Q/A, 40% multi-turn chat, 20% long context) — Samantha to confirm dataset access.
- Model variants: rw-13b-fp16 + rw-13b-int8 fallback for cost tests (Dev to provision).
- Traffic pattern: 60 TPS sustained bursts, median latency target 200ms p95.

2) Success metrics (pass/fail):
- Latency: p95 < 200ms for rw-13b-fp16 under test load.
- Correctness: BLEU/QA F1 baseline agreement >= 92% vs. your golden set.
- Cost: token cost <= $0.003/token for production estimate with caching turned on.
- Reliability: <1% error rate (5xx / timeouts) during the 48h window.

3) Ownership & next steps:
- Samantha / Orchid: provide dataset and any LLM output acceptance tests by 2027-05-13 17:00 PT.
- Dev: provision dedicated staging pool + quantized variant by 2027-05-14 EOD.
- Marissa: finalize mutual action plan and procurement milestone for Dedicated trial; send PO checklist.
- Evelyn: run coordination calls and escalate blockers to CS/Eng as needed.

4) Known risks & initial mitigations (we'll track these in the thread):
- Risk A: Long-tail prompts cause KV cache thrashing -> Mitigation: cap sequence length to 1024 during test, enable prefix caching.
- Risk B: Network egress peaks impacting latency -> Mitigation: schedule test during low region traffic window and run from our us-west-2 pool.
- Risk C (blocking): Your internal schema includes binary attachments in prompts (images) — will require multimodal model or pre-extraction. If images are required, this will block the existing test path.

Attachments: I dropped a proposed success metric spreadsheet and a staging network diagram in the Drive link below.

Next: if you confirm dataset availability today we'll schedule the staging window for Fri 2027-05-14 02:00–04:00 PT (48h run start).

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn_hart@redwood.com | M: +1-415-555-0198

Thanks Evelyn — this looks great and matches our expectations. A couple quick points:

- Dataset: we can provide the 5k prompt set by EOD 2027-05-13. It includes 150 image prompts (we had noted this in the discovery). Those image prompts are small PNGs — we'll attach them to the dataset export.
- Acceptance tests: I'll upload the golden answers CSV and expected F1 targets to the shared Drive by tomorrow.
- Timing: Fri start is OK for us, but if image prompts require a different execution path we may need to delay.

Action: I'll work with our infra lead (orchidai-poc@orchidai.com) to flag any image-handling constraints today.

— Samantha
Samantha Li
Head of ML Product | Orchid AI
samantha@orchidai.com
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: orchidai-poc@orchidai.com
Date: 2027-05-12T14:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staging test scope & success metrics — technical constraints and blockers

Evelyn / team — quick technical note after a first pass on the dataset preview:

1) Image prompts (blocking):
- Current hosted model family for this trial is text-only. Supporting the 150 image prompts will require either (A) pre-extracting image captions on Orchid's side and passing them as text, or (B) routing image prompts to our experimental multimodal endpoint (not GA), which has undisclosed latency characteristics.
- Recommendation: proceed with text-only subset for initial 48h run (drop image prompts) to validate latency/cost/reliability, then run a second multimodal-focused validation once the caption pipeline is in place.

2) Long-turn chats:
- Observed a small number of sessions in the dataset with >8k tokens; those will blow past the KV cache practical limits for the staging pool.
- Mitigation: clip to last 2.5k tokens or run a separate long-context bucket; we'll flag these sessions in the dataset and exclude from the main pass unless you want us to run a separate extended run.

3) Network & egress:
- If Orchid wants regionally colocated infra we can try us-east-1 or us-west-2; for lowest latency choose us-west-2.
- We'll provision a dedicated pool and pin instances to those AZs for the run window.

4) Escalation path if we hit a blocking bug during run:
- Level 1 (On-call): Redwood SRE (pager), CS engineer (Connor Obrien) — immediate triage within 15m.
- Level 2 (Platform): Dev + Infra lead -> hotfix or fallback model variant within 2–4h.
- Level 3 (Exec): Evelyn + Director of Product + Customer success lead for SLA exceptions / go/no-go decisions.

I'll start provisioning the pool and post the ETA for readiness (aiming for 05-14 09:00 PT provisioning complete).

— Dev
Dev Patel
Staff Software Engineer, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Staging test scope & success metrics — scheduling and contingency plan

Samantha — thanks for confirming. A couple of operational items:

- Let's aim to run the initial 48h test with the text-only subset (drop the 150 images) on Fri 2027-05-14 02:00 PT start. That lets us validate the core success metrics quickly.
- After the initial run, we will schedule a multimodal follow-up once Orchid provides either (a) pre-extracted captions or (b) green light to hit experimental multimodal endpoint.

I've updated the Drive folder with a short mutual action plan (link above) and a contingency matrix. Connor — FYI: please stand by as CS lead for any customer-impacting escalations during the run.

Open blocker we need to resolve before start:
- Dataset delivery (Samantha) — EOD 2027-05-13. If we miss that, we postpone to Monday 2027-05-17.
- Dev: provisioned pool ETA 05-14 09:00 PT. Please confirm.

I'll host a 15m pre-run check-in Thu 2027-05-13 16:00 PT to confirm dataset, pool health, and run keys. Invite forthcoming.

Thanks,
Evelyn
